text.p: - Delegations of the five states of former Yugoslavia meet in Brussels on Monday and Tuesday to debate succession issues.
- Slovenian president Milan Kucan started a six-day visit to China on Monday.
- Slovenian parties must decide their candidates by October 16 for the general election due on November 10.
- Two Slovenian mountaineers have been missing in the Himalayas since October 4.
- A Slovenian team won the first prize out of 1,432 contestants in a sailing competition in Trieste, Italy. This is the third year in a row the Slovenian team has come top.
- Slovenian managers' salaries make up 11 percent of total expenditure for salaries each month, statistics show.
- A three-day scientific forum started in Bled on Sunday.
- According to statistics the average Slovenian consumes about 35 kilograms of fruit each year, two thirds less than the average German.
